name: plain-language
description: syntax highlighting, a run button and discord rich presence for plain, the language you write in words

plain.folder.description: folder that has boot.py and plain.plain. leave empty to use the folder of the file you're running.

plain.python.description: python command. leave empty for python3 (py on windows).

plain.discord.enabled.description: show 'coding in plain' on discord while a .plain file is open.

plain.discord.clientId.description: your discord application id (discord.com/developers/applications). its name is what discord shows after 'playing'.
